questions.question: Write the equation of a line parallel to y = -2x + 5 and passing through (1, -3).
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have the same slope. Original line has slope -2. Point (1, -3): y - (-3) = -2(x - 1) ⇒ y + 3 = -2x + 2 ⇒ y = -2x - 1.
steps: 1. Parallel lines have equal slopes: m = -2.
questions.fastStrategy: Parallel lines: same slope; perpendicular: negative reciprocal slope.
